notes.title: The New Demo Is Out – And It Starts with a Bang!
notes.notes:
Hey friends,

I just uploaded the new demo for Death Row Escape! This time, you jump right into the action no slow intro, no hand-holding. Things get intense fast, and I can't wait to hear what you think.

I also put together a brand new trailer to go along with it. It’s short, to the point, and gives a better feel for the atmosphere I'm going for.

Your feedback really helps me shape the game, so if you give the demo a try, I’d love to hear your thoughts.

Thanks so much for the support,
SE Games Studio

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’ve been working hard to bring you a more immersive and intense experience in Death Row Escape. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 Bodycam Perspective: The game now features a gritty bodycam view, putting you right in the heart of the action.
🔹 Censored Enemy Faces: To add an unsettling and mysterious vibe, the enemies' faces are now censored. It’s both eerie and intriguing!
🔹 Jumpscares Added: Get ready for some unexpected moments to keep you on edge.
🔹 Optimization Improvements: The game runs smoother than ever, ensuring a seamless experience on a variety of systems.

I’m super excited to hear your thoughts on these changes! Let me know what you think, and as always, your feedback is invaluable.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of this journey! 🚀

(Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to stay updated!)

notes.title: Death Row Escape is Now Live on Steam
notes.notes: Hello everyone! I'm excited to share that the Steam page and demo for the game I've been working on are finally live! I'd really appreciate it if you could give it a try and share your feedback with me. Even if you don’t get a chance to play, adding it to your Steam wishlist would be a huge support. Every bit of support truly means a lot to me during this journey. Thank you all in advance!
